questions.question: A solid metallic cylinder with a base radius of 3 cm and a height 120 of cm is melted and recast into a sphere of radius r cm. What is the value of r if there is a 10% metal loss in the conversion?
questions.solution:
Given:

Base radius of the cylinder = 3 cm 

Height of the cylinder = 120 cm.

Concept used:

The volume of a cylinder = π × R2 × H unit³ (R & H being the radius and the height of the cylinder respectively)

The volume of a sphere = 4/3 × π × r3 (r being the radius of the sphere)

Calculation:

Volume of the metallic cylinder = π × 3² × 120 = 1080π cm³

Effective metallic volume = 1080π - 1080π × 10% = 972π cm3

According to the question,

4/3 × π × r³ = 972π

⇒ r3 = 729

⇒ r = 9

**∴ The radius of the recast sphere is 9 cm.**

questions.question: Pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 30 hours, 36 hours and 28 hours, respectively, All the three pipes were opened simultaneously. If A and C were closed 5 hours and 8 hours, respectively, before the tank was filled completely, then in how many hours was the tank filled ?
questions.solution:
Given:

Pipes A, B, and C can fill a tank in 30 hours, 36 hours, and 28 hours, respectively.

A and C were closed 5 hours and 8 hours, respectively, before the tank was filled completely.

Concept used:

Entire work = work done hourly × total time taken in hours

Calculation:

LCM (30, 36, 28) = 1260

Let the capacity of the tank be the LCM of the time taken by all of the pipes.

So, the capacity of the tank = 1260 unit

Hence,

A fills the tank by = 1260 ÷ 30 = 42 units per hour

B fills the tank by = 1260 ÷ 36 = 35 units per hour

C fills the tank by = 1260 ÷ 28 = 45 units per hour

Let the total time taken to fill the tank be Q hours.

According to the question,

42 (Q - 5) + 35Q + 45 (Q - 8) = 1260

⇒ 122Q = 1830

⇒ Q = 15

**∴ The tank was filled in 15 hours.**

questions.question: A and B can do a certain work in 12 and 18 days. respectively. They work together for 5 days. The remaining work was completed by C alone in 27 (1)/(2) days, What part of the same work can be completed by A, B and C together in 6 days?
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B can do certain work in 12 and 18 days. respectively.

They work together for 5 days.

The remaining work was completed by C alone in 27 (1)/(2) days

Concept used:

Entire work = work done daily × total time taken in days

Calculation:

LCM (12, 18) = 36

Let the entire work be the LCM of the time taken by A and B.

So, the entire work = 36 units

Hence,

Daily A does = 36 ÷ 12 = 3 units

Daily B does = 36 ÷ 18 = 2 units

In 5 days, finished work = 5 × (3 + 2) = 25 units

Remaining work = 36 - 25 = 11 units

Daily C does = 11 ÷ 27 (1)/(2) = 0.4 units

In 6 days, A, B and C together do = 6 × (3 + 2 + 0.4) = 32.4 units

Part of the work = 32.4/36 = 9/10

**∴ 9/10 part of the same work can be completed by A, B and C together in 6 days.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 4,000 is lent at 10% p.a., interest compounded annually. What is the difference between the compound interest for the 2ⁿd year and the 3rd year?
questions.solution:
Given:

Interest rate = 10%

Principal Amount = Rs. 4000

Time = 3 years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Principal amount become at the end of the second year = 4000 (1 + 10/100)² = Rs. 4840

Principal amount at the beginning of the second year = 4000 (1 + 10/100)¹ = Rs. 4400

Interest incurred in the second year = 4840 - 4400 = Rs. 440

Principal amount become at the end of 3rd year = 4000 (1 + 10/100)3 = Rs. 5324

Principal amount at the beginning of the third year = Rs. 4840

Interest incurred in the third year = 5324 - 4840 = Rs. 484

Difference between the compound interest incurred in the third and second year = 484 - 440 = Rs. 44

**∴ Rs. 44 is the difference between the compound interest for the 2nd year and the 3rd year.**

questions.question: The speed of a bus without stoppages is 40 km/h and with stoppages is 32 km/h. How many minutes per hour does the bus stop?
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed without stoppages = 40kmph

Speed with stoppages = 32kmph

Calculation:

Stopping time = (Difference between speed)/(Maximum speed) × 60

Reduction in speed = 40 - 32 = 8 kmph

Minutes per hour the bus stops = 8/40 × 60 = 12

**∴ 12 minutes per hour the bus stops.**

According to the question,

⇒ P + 200 + 0.2P + 40 = 1.25P + 200

⇒ 1.2P + 240 = 1.25P + 200

⇒ P = 800

questions.question: The price of an article increases by 20% every year. If the difference between the price of the article at the end of the third year and at the end of the fourth year is Rs. 324, what is the price of the article at the end of the second year ?
questions.solution:
Given:

The price of an article increases by 20% every year. 

The difference between the price of the article at the end of the third year and at the end of the fourth year is Rs. 324.

Concept used:

Compound interest = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate of interest per year

N = time in years

Calculation:

Let the initial price of the article be Rs. P.

The price of the article at the end of the fourth year = Rs. P(1 + 20/100)4

The price of the article at the end of the third year = Rs. P(1 + 20/100)3

The price of the article at the end of the second year = Rs. P(1 + 20/100)2

According to the question,

P(1 + 20/100)⁴ - P(1 + 20/100)3 = 324

⇒ P × 1.2⁴ - P × 1.2³ = 324

⇒ P × 1.2³ (1.2 - 1) = 324

⇒ P × 1.728 × 0.2 = 324

⇒ P = 937.5

⇒ P(1 + 20/100)2 = 1350

**∴ Rs. 1350 is the price of the article at the end of the second year.**

questions.question: If a person walks with a speed of 8 (1)/(3)m/sec, he reaches his destination on time. He covers (2)/(3)part of the journey in (5)/(8) part of time. With what speed (in km/h) should he cover the remaining distance to reach the destination on time.
questions.solution:
Given:

The person walks with a speed of 8 (1)/(3)m/sec.

He covers (2)/(3) part of the journey in (5)/(8) part of time. 

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

Kmph = Mps × 3.6

Calculation:

Let the total distance be 2400Q meters.

Hence, time taken to cover the entire distance = {2400Q over {25 over 3}} = 288Q sec

Thus,

2/3 part of the journey = 2400Q × { 2 over 3} = 1600Q meters

5/8 part of the time = 288Q × {5 over 8} = 180Q secs

Remaining time = (288 - 180)Q = 108Q secs

Remaining distance = (2400 - 1600)Q = 800Q meters

Hence, his sped should be = 800 ÷ 108 = {200 over 27} mps

Now, his speed in kmph = {200 over 27} × 3.6 = 26 {2 over 3} kmph

**∴ With 26 {2 over 3} kmph he should cover the remaining distance to reach the destination on time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let total time to cover the distance = t sec

velocity of the person = 8 (1)/(3)sec = (25)/(3) sec

As we know

Distance = speed × time

D = (25)/(3) × t 

Now, he covers { 2 over 3} part of journey (distance) in {5 over 8}part of time i.e t

thus, for remaining journey i.e. {1 over 3} part will have to cover in {5 over 8} part of time i.e t 

Thus,

frac{{1}}{3}times frac{{25}}{3} times t = V times (3)/(8)t

v = frac{{200}}{27}m/s

v = 80/3 kmph

v = 26 (2)/(3) kmph

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 12,384 is divided between A, B, C and D such that the ratio of the shares of A and B is 3 : 4, that of B and C is 5 : 6, and that of C and D is 8 : 9. What is the share of C ?
questions.solution:
Given:

A : B = 3 : 4

B : C = 5 : 6

C : D = 8 : 9

Sum to divided among them = Rs. 12,384

Concept used:

Ratio Proportion

Calculation:

A : B = 3 : 4 = 15 : 20

B : C = 5 : 6 = 20 : 24

C : D = 8 : 9 = 24 : 27

A : B : C : D = 15 : 20 : 24 : 27

Share of C = 24/(15 + 20 + 24 + 27) × 12384 = Rs. 3456

**∴ The share of C is Rs. 3456.**

questions.question: Let x be the least number between 56,000 and 60,000 which when divided by 40, 45, 50 and 55 leaves a remainder of 23 in each case. What is the sum of the digits of x ?
questions.solution:
Given:

x is the least number between 56,000 and 60,000 which when divided by 40, 45, 50, and 55 leaves a remainder of 23 in each case.

Concept used:

The least common multiple of two numbers is the “smallest non-zero common number” which is a multiple of both the numbers.

Calculation:

LCM (40, 45, 50, 55) = 19800

Calculating the approximate quotient, we get = 50000 ÷ 19800 ≈ 2

So, the required number must be the sum of the next multiple of 19800 and 23.

Hence, the required number = 19800 × (2 + 1) + 23 = 59423

So, x = 59423

Now, the sum of digits of 59423 = 5 + 9 + 4 + 2 + 3 = 23

**∴ The sum of the digits of x is 23.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**LCM (40, 45, 50, 55) = 19800

19800K + 23

Let k = 3,

19800 × 3 + 23 = 59400 + 23 = 59423

**Therefore, sum of digits of x = 5 + 9 + 4 + 2 + 3 = 23**

questions.question: The ratio of copper and zinc in alloy A is 5 : 7 and that in alloy B is 4 : 5. A and B are taken in the ratio of 1 : 2 and mixed to form a new alloy C. What part of C is copper?
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of copper and zine in alloy A is 5 : 7 and that in alloy B is 4 : 5. 

A and B are taken in the ratio of 1 : 2 and mixed to form a new alloy C.

Concept used:

Ratio Proportion

Calculation:

Let the common ratio be Q.

Amount of alloy A = Q units

Amount of alloy B = 2Q units

Copper amount in,

Alloy A = 5/12 × Q = 5Q/12 units

Alloy B = 4/9 × 2Q = 8Q/9 units

Alloy C = 5Q/12 + 8Q/9 = 47Q/36 units

Total alloy C = Q + 2Q = 3Q units

Copper as a part of alloy C = 47Q/36 ÷ 3Q = 47/108

**∴ 47/108 part of C is copper. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Alloy A, part of Copper = 5/12 × 1 = 5/12

Alloy B, part of Copper = 4/9 × 2 = 8/9

Alloy C, part of Copper = 5/12 + 8/9 = 47/36

Copper as a part of alloy C = 47/36 ÷ (1 + 2) = 47/108

∴ 47/108 part of C is copper.
